mapper.select: SELECT bai.account_item_id AS accountItemId, bai.account_item_name AS accountItemName, IFNULL(SUM(bbpd.principal_amount), 0 ) AS totalAmount, IFNULL(SUM(bbpd.bonus_amount), 0) AS bonusAmount FROM base_account_item bai LEFT JOIN ( SELECT bbpd.account_item_id, SUM(bbpd.principal_amount) AS principal_amount, SUM(bbpd.bonus_amount) AS bonus_amount FROM base_bill_pay_detail bbpd WHERE bbpd.bill_pay_id = #{billPayId} GROUP BY bbpd.bill_pay_id ) bbpd ON bai.account_item_id = bbpd.account_item_id GROUP BY bai.account_type_id, bai.account_item_id, bai.account_item_name, bbpd.principal_amount ORDER BY bai.account_type_id, bai.account_item_id
